basic_profile.bio: Born and raised in the UK, I'm a lifelong learner with a passion for orthodontics and dentistry. By day, I work as a dental technician, crafting smiles and ensuring teeth align perfectly. In my spare time, I dive deep into the world of Pokémon, especially enjoying the adventures in Pokémon Sun and Moon. I also enjoy connecting with fellow enthusiasts in 'BrothersSection' where we discuss everything from sibling dynamics to shared hobbies. I value my quiet evenings at home, typically online after work hours from 7 PM to midnight GMT. Happily married with two kids, I'm a firm believer in lifelong education and staying updated with the latest in my field. My dislikes include misinformation and lack of dental hygiene.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have over two decades of experience in the dental field, which began with a formal education in dental technology. Over the years, I've attended numerous workshops and seminars to hone my craft and keep up with the latest orthodontic techniques. My expertise is self-enhanced through dedicated reading and participation in orthodontic forums.
